best_single_signal_baseline.candidate_features: same frozen B41D eligible feature columns by position
best_single_signal_baseline.prediction: selected normalized feature itself, full-development median imputation, clipped to [0,1]
best_single_signal_baseline.selection: lowest six-season LOSO mean MAE across 2019-2024; lexicographic feature name wins exact tie

frozen_model_evaluation.model: exact B41F final 2019-2024 nonnegative ridge model, separately by position
frozen_model_evaluation.tiers: exact unchanged B41E position-specific six thresholds producing seven ordered labels

holdout_data_quality_gates.failure_action: SCIENTIFIC_STOP_DATA_INTEGRITY; do not reinterpret performance gates and do not deploy

holdout_row_construction.active_game_definition: same frozen B41B definition: game with documented offensive, defensive, or special-teams participation; injury absences are not automatically zero-role games
holdout_row_construction.future_snap_target: mean snap share over the same next four active games, transformed to origin-week within-position midrank percentile; K excluded from snap monotonicity test
holdout_row_construction.primary_target: next-4-active-game frozen-league-scored fantasy points per active game, transformed to origin-week within-position midrank percentile

test_1_error_vs_baseline.bootstrap_cluster: origin_week; resample the 11 holdout origin weeks with replacement and preserve all rows in each selected cluster
test_1_error_vs_baseline.interpretation: strict out-of-sample superiority to the frozen minimum credible benchmark
test_1_error_vs_baseline.metric: macro-position mean of paired MAE difference = MAE(B41F)-MAE(frozen best-single-signal baseline)
test_1_error_vs_baseline.pass_rule: upper 95% CI bound for macro-position MAE difference must be strictly < 0.0

test_2_spearman_association.bootstrap_cluster: origin_week with the same 20,000-replicate seed-locked bootstrap
test_2_spearman_association.metric: pooled Spearman rank correlation between frozen B41F score and primary target percentile across all holdout rows
test_2_spearman_association.pass_rule: lower 95% CI bound must be strictly > 0.0

test_3_ordered_tier_future_production.aggregation: pool the standardized within-position target percentiles across positions by frozen role tier
test_3_ordered_tier_future_production.pass_rule: mean primary target percentile must be non-decreasing from Speculative through Elite with zero adjacent inversions

test_4_ordered_tier_future_snap_share.aggregation: pool standardized within-position future-snap percentiles across snap-relevant positions by frozen role tier
test_4_ordered_tier_future_snap_share.pass_rule: mean future-snap percentile must be non-decreasing from Speculative through Elite with zero adjacent inversions

purpose: Freeze the exact one-shot 2025 evaluation and final best-single-signal comparison baseline before B41C3 and before opening 2025.
secondary_descriptive_only: per-position B41F MAE and baseline MAE
per-position tier counts and tier target means
per-position future-snap tier means where applicable

single_final_decision_rule.fail: any data-quality gate or any primary holdout test fails
single_final_decision_rule.failure_consequence: no production deployment; preserve evidence; this V2 version closes or requires a newly preregistered version with a genuinely untouched future test
single_final_decision_rule.pass: all data-quality gates and all four primary holdout tests pass exactly as frozen
